[!fuzz] skip

# Check that []byte arguments have independent backing storage during fuzzing.
# Regression test for golang/go#71831.

[short] skip
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache

go test -run=FuzzNoOverlap -fuzz=FuzzNoOverlap -fuzztime=1000x -parallel=1

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.20
-- fuzz_test.go --
package fuzz

import (
	"testing"
	"unsafe"
)

// overlap reports whether the memory backing a and b, up to their
// capacities, overlaps. Appending to one argument must not change another.
func overlap(a, b []byte) bool {
	if cap(a) == 0 || cap(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	pa := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	pb := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	return pa < pb+uintptr(cap(b)) && pb < pa+uintptr(cap(a))
}

func FuzzNoOverlap(f *testing.F) {
	f.Add([]byte("abc"), []byte("xyz"), []byte("123"))
	f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, a, b, c []byte) {
		if overlap(a, b) || overlap(a, c) || overlap(b, c) {
			t.Fatalf("arguments share memory: a=%q b=%q c=%q", a, b, c)
		}
	})
}
